units.source_text: 我和哥哥的床铺是并排的，睡前这么聊几句。

en.t: My elder brother's bedding and mine were laid side by side, and before going to sleep we would exchange a few words like this.

units.source_text: 在哥哥的脑子里，在我的心里，都觉得父亲的病肯定没救了。

en.t: In my elder brother's mind, and in my own heart as well, we both felt that Father's illness was surely beyond saving.

units.source_text: 甚至想到既然没救了的话，那么……就仿佛我们做儿子的在等着父亲死一样。

en.t: I even thought that if there really was no hope, then... it was almost as if we, his sons, were waiting for our father to die.

units.source_text: 可是做儿子的又不敢说穿，而且我们哥儿俩都很清楚对方在想什么。

en.t: But as sons we did not dare say it outright, and both of us brothers understood perfectly well what the other was thinking.

units.source_text: “父亲还以为自己会好起来呢。”

en.t: "Father still thinks he is going to get better."
My elder brother said to me.

units.source_text: 事实上也的确如哥哥所说的那样。

en.t: In fact, things were indeed just as my elder brother said.

units.source_text: 乡亲们一来探望，父亲就非要见见人家。

en.t: Whenever people from the village came to visit, Father insisted on seeing them.

units.source_text: 见了面又总是念叨一通没有办成酒席，很是遗憾，并一再表示等自己病好了一定补办。

en.t: Once he saw them, he would always go on about how sorry he was that he had not been able to hold the banquet, and he kept saying that once he recovered he would certainly make up for it.
"It is just as well your graduation banquet was not held.

units.source_text: 我那时候可真是受罪啊。”

en.t: I had a terrible time back then."

units.source_text: 哥哥的话勾起了我的回忆。

en.t: My elder brother's words stirred up my memories.

units.source_text: 我想起当时人们喝得一塌糊涂的情景，不由得苦笑起来，眼前浮现出父亲一桌桌劝酒的神情，心里很不是滋味。

en.t: I remembered how thoroughly drunk everyone had been at the time and could not help smiling bitterly; Father's manner as he went from table to table urging people to drink rose before my eyes, and it left me feeling deeply uncomfortable.
